reviews.text:
Completely unusable for blind user. REVIEW: As a blind person who relies on VoiceOver on iPhone, this app is not accessible at all . Many buttons and controls are unlabeled or unannounced, navigation is chaotic, and I simply cannot complete basic tasks without sighted help. This isn’t a minor inconvenience it makes the app unusable for screen reader users.

VoiceOver support is not about toggling a setting it means all elements must be labelled and operable, and YOU must test that with real assistive tech. Right now, Amino fails basic screen reader navigation and control accessibility. There is absolutely no reason in 2026 for a social app to leave blind people out. Other apps manage this there’s no excuse.

If you want to call this an “inclusive community app,” you need to make it actually usable with VoiceOver . Not “half-baked compatibility,” not “kind of works in places.” Full accessibility compliance means blind users can perform all core functions without assistance.

Fix this. Respect accessibility. We deserve access not an afterthought. ￼ Why this hits harder • It calls out usability, not just preference.

reviews.text: Big step backwards. Had the previous app. Was forced to migrate to the new app, and after a week, I’ve decided to stop using it altogether. The new app will not give you partial credit for your 10,000 steps like the old one did. And even if you take 10,000 steps to get full credit, you must open the app, wait for it to recognize the step count, and wait longer to receive the points. Didn’t take 10K steps? You get nothing. Took 10K steps and didn’t open your app at the end of the day? You get nothing. Took 10K steps, saw it in the app, it didn’t wait until your balance updated? You get nothing (exactly what happened to me on Sept 21). Also, the new app requires hundreds of thousands of points to get any gift cards or useful value, which may take many months to earn, unless you stream yoga videos everyday. There is no more leaderboard or community-focused features that made the old app fun. Lastly, if you were using the old app, you have to go through a very convoluted process to get your old tokens (which seem to be dropping in value steadily). Just another generic “fitness” app, which is a shame.
